protocol:
Measure what changes when the first-listen captioner uses its learned AudioCaps task embedding instead of the default Clotho task embedding. Both describe the same unmodified waveform, see no image or source hint and use identical weights, search, acceptance and memory. Do not expose both descriptions as independent witnesses. Current and candidate use one open caption per channel per window. Keep speech, other estimates, images and model prompt identical. No changes to the speech quotation rule. Compare with the released audio-only human descriptions, withholding them from every reader. First select up to 40 additional previously untested AVCaps test sources with at least three different sound descriptions, readable streams and original duration 12–65 seconds, sorted by SHA-256 of reel-caption-style-holdout-1/<source>. Use both encodings for every whole released passage in every film, compare the duration- and channel-weighted mean embedding of the open captions to same-film human descriptions versus other films. Resample films as pairs across conditions. Use the published 12-film/24-assignment crossover as a separate frozen downstream measurement in fresh Codex sessions. Primary downstream outcome is paired sound discrimination, as defined in check_track_recall.py, with picture and original audiovisual descriptions as secondary measures. Audit incorrect speech quotations and door/silence. Check an independent environmental source collection to detect regressions in descriptions outside video. If outcomes do not support a general default change, keep the incumbent default and publish the audit.
Independent environment checks use all 20 already cached Clotho evaluation field recordings from Reel's previous source-blind draw (five independent captions each) and the already cached 50 ESC-50 sounds, one per class. Use Clotho for the same open-caption endpoint. Use ESC-50 as a separate exploratory 50-way retrieval with dataset class names. The field recordings and ESC sounds are outside the AVCaps dataset but were used previously for other experiments in Reel; only the 40-film AVCaps draw is novel here. Preserve condition differences and bootstrap whole sources with both conditions. Inspect both a correctly followed change and a miss, retaining all answers.

reproduction.interpretation: Open-caption scores average cosine to listeners describing the same recording minus mean cosine to listeners describing other recordings. Model streams weight each new sample once per recorded channel. A silent channel contributes zero. Human references are held out one at a time. Intervals for changes resample complete sources or complete source pairs within the comparison bank. No new reader sessions are simulated by these intervals.
